name: ccrig
description: CCRig as a mod: your plan usage above the prompt and on the spinner, a toast before you hit a limit, /ccrig with no Claude turn, and the usage-limit guardian.

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: auto: the full bar when no CCRig status line is wired, else only limit alerts. always: the full bar. alerts: only limit alerts. off: nothing.

spinner.title: Usage on the spinner
spinner.description: Show the plan usage window to watch beside the spinner while Claude works.

alerts.title: Limit toasts
alerts.description: Show a toast when a usage window crosses your warn or critical line.
